card.name: FDA companion diagnostics URL ending
card.fires_on: Mostly the ".gov" after "www.fda" in links to FDA companion diagnostics pages. Also fires weakly on a few scattered word starts or parts of medical terms.

modes.label: FDA link domain
modes.description: The ".gov" ending in an FDA companion diagnostics web address that follows a sentence about FDA-authorized tests.
modes.example: Information on FDA-authorized tests for the detection of ESR1 mutations in breast cancer is available at: https://www.fda<<.gov>>/CompanionDiagnostics.

modes.label: Partway through medical terms
modes.description: Inside or at the start of a disease or section term such as dermatitis or plaque psoriasis.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Seborrheic<< dermat>>itis including seborrhea sicca

card.plain: It mainly marks the end of the FDA web address that points to approved companion tests for a drug.
